description: Chronological log of every file created or edited by Claude Code in this documentation project, across sessions. Complements git history with the why behind each change; git log/diff already has the exact before/after content. Newest entries at the bottom.

revisions.summary: Fixed a note pointing at app/schema/1.0.0/index.json, a path that no longer exists in scaffolds. Now points at the flat app/schema.json plus a link to schema build.
Was generic and tool-agnostic. Added the real schema.json file shape, field format, the deprecated flag's role, and how it feeds into the app-level committed artifact via schema build.
Rewritten around the actual plan/apply/contract workflow, compatibilityFloor, and the exact boot-time checks and error strings, replacing a generic tool-agnostic checklist.
New CLI reference page for servable schema build/plan/apply/contract; no reference existed for this command group before.
New CLI reference page for servable protocol new/add/eject/document/community; flags community list and protocol test as non-functional stubs rather than documenting them as working features.
New CLI reference page for servable model add and its schema.json write-back.

Documented the two-call adaptConfig sequence precisely, including the adaptedBasic guard verified live against a real boot (a first draft repeated an unverified claim from a commit message; corrected after instrumenting and testing it directly).

Added the real docker-compose mechanics: dynamic port reassignment via getPortNear, x-servable-envs, the system.docker.namespace isolation feature, and the fingerprint-vs-manual-docker-changes gotcha.
Added a note that Route.define() is async and must be awaited by its caller, otherwise a registration failure is a silently swallowed rejection.

Corrected the health route registration row; it previously suggested verifying startup completed as the fix, which is insufficient given a fully successful boot can still silently fail to register the route.
Added a cross-reference at the health-check registration step to the Route.define await requirement. Rest of the page was checked and found accurate, no other changes needed.
Added a cross-link to the protocol schema reference page.

New symptom-first guide covering port drift after container recreation, manually recreated containers not being re-adopted, container name conflicts, and the system.docker.namespace isolation feature.

New guide covering the log-reading process used throughout the session: read the first error not the last, confirm launch actually finished, distinguish transient boot-race noise from real failures, and a table of common failure signatures.
Linked the two new guides (local-development, debugging-boot-failures) into the related-guides list.
Fixed a broken relative link (../protocol/index) caught by a real yarn build; Docusaurus does not generate that route for an index.mdx file. Corrected to ../protocol/.

Added docusaurus-plugin-llms, the Docusaurus equivalent of the fumadocs llms.txt/llms-full.txt routes already used in web/support. Verified with a real local build since the plugin declares a peer dependency on Docusaurus 3.x while this site runs 2.4.3.

Restructured so the actual pitch leads instead of the experimental warning; named the Parse Server dependency and the single-implemented-engine reality up front instead of only in the FAQ; linked to the new comparison page.
Same restructuring as docs/overview.mdx: pitch before the experimental warning, and corrected a stale reference to 'generator-servable' (the actual orchestrator is @servable/server).

New page: Servable vs Express, Fastify, NestJS, and plain Parse Server, including a comparison table and honest guidance on when one of the alternatives is the better starting point. Requested after auditing the site's LLM-discovery messaging and finding no comparison content existed anywhere.
Added a real one-line summary before the logo image (its first line was previously just the image, producing a meaningless llms.txt description) and a forward link to the new comparison page.

Rewrote the opening paragraph; the original first line (bold-italic text plus a raw
tag) produced a garbled llms.txt description, flagged by the docusaurus-plugin-llms build warning.
Added a real intro sentence; the page's first content was a JSX component with no text, also flagged by the build warning.
Added a one-line description before the logo image, and a frontmatter block (previously had none).
Added a one-line description before the logo image so its llms.txt entry is a real sentence.
Added a one-line description before the logo image so its llms.txt entry is a real sentence.
Added a one-line description before the logo image so its llms.txt entry is a real sentence.
Moved the experimental-warning admonition below the real intro paragraph; it was the actual first content, leaking into this page's llms.txt description as the literal string ':::info'.

Same fix as docs/reference/overview.mdx (admonition leaking into the llms.txt description), plus updated the pitch to name Parse Server directly instead of the vaguer 'framework engine of choice', matching the corrected framing in docs/overview.mdx.

New reference page for servable-core/vscode: activation, dependency resolution (including two implementation gotchas found and fixed while building it - @servable/cli's broken exports map, and process.execPath being Electron's helper binary rather than plain node in the extension host), views, commands, and the buildSchema hydration fix and its remaining known limitation (Protocol.loader null issue).
New task-oriented guide: install, activate, use each view, create and eject a protocol.
Linked the new using-the-vscode-extension guide into the related-guides list.
Added the new VS Code Extension reference page to the in-this-section list.

Added the new servable-core/vscode extension to the package catalog. Left the page's existing stale content (servable-community org links, CLI described as a yeoman generator - both no longer accurate) untouched since fixing those was out of scope for this change.

Fixed the stale content flagged in the entry above: servable-community org links corrected to the actual servable-core repos, and the CLI's 'yeoman generator' description corrected (it's a plain Node CLI, not built on yeoman).

Fixed --bridgeframeworkId, a flag name that doesn't exist in the actual command (the real field is --engineId), and corrected appDescription's documented default value. Found while cross-checking every CLI reference page against its real command source for an exhaustive documentation pass.

Replaced fabricated option specs (a nonexistent -u shorthand, a copied-in-error '[default: 1387]' on a session token and a boolean confirm flag) with the real options read directly from login.js/logout.js/status.js.
Added the previously-undocumented 'protocol community submit' command and its real options.

New, first-ever reference for the @servable/tools package's full public API: buildSchema, validateSchema, compileArtifact/normalizeArtifact/artifactHashOf, plan, the manifest system (extractProtocol/accessManifest/ManifestEnums), documentProtocol/generateGithubReadme, cleanProtocols, and Domain.Servable. Documents a real inverted-condition bug found in protocolApiVersion.js's version-dispatch logic.

New deep-dive on route request handling: the difference between request.params (path) and params (query + auto-merged W3C trace context), requireUser/requireStepUp semantics and their distinct 209/449 error codes, the 500-not-520 exception handling gotcha (520 collides with Cloudflare's own synthetic error code), route-level cache (including a real behavioral inconsistency between the memory and Redis backends for a zero/falsy window), and rate limiting.
Linked the new route-handling.mdx deep-dive.

New reference for Servable.App.Transaction: the one-write-kind-per-transaction v1 scope, the Parse Server engine's real MongoDB-session-backed implementation, its automatic standalone-MongoDB sequential fallback, and a subtle Parse pending-ops-leak bug the engine works around after a failed transactional batch.

Rewritten around the real manual-vs-auto seed mechanics: auto-seed's content-and-logic hash-based re-run detection (hashes transformer/validator function source, not just data), dependency-ordered seeding, and the SeedState persistence model - replacing a generic tool-agnostic checklist.

New reference for Servable.App.Object: the Proxy-based class-map resolution that closes a real Parse gap (new Parse.Object(className) doesn't apply protocol mixins; this makes it match fromJSON's behavior), and why it's implemented as a Proxy rather than Parse.Object.extend().

Deepened the trigger execution section with a real, previously-undocumented finding: afterSave's protocol- and class-level trigger calls are made without await inside a try/catch, so an error thrown there is a silent unhandled rejection, never reaching the '[Class ...] afterSave' error log - the same class of bug documented for Route.define() in route-job-contracts.mdx. Also documented the dual-casing trigger lookup and the _Session skip.

New reference for the two-tier authentication system: the legacy session-token cookie, the opt-in AUTH_JWT_SECRET-gated access/refresh JWT pair, refresh token rotation with reuse detection, device binding, and per-session step-up freshness.

Restored a missing 'import React from react' that a parallel content edit (commit 2fec608) had accidentally dropped, which broke the entire site's SSR build (ReferenceError: React is not defined on the homepage). Found because a full local build is run before every push in this session; fixed since it blocked deploying everything else in this round.
